abuddhavacana.p: [Na+buddhavacana] (na) CL=8 Words that are not the words of the Blessed One. The words that are the opposite of the Blessed one/the Buddha. See also pariyattisaddhammapatirūpaka

abuddhi.p: [Na+buddhi] (thī) CL=10 (1) Ignorance. See. Abuddhivihatatta(Ti) (2) Ignorant; Ignorant person. Fool.

DOP: buddhi f. [ ts ], intelligence; understanding; Abh 152 (~i medhā matī); 1034 (vijjā … ~iyaṃ); D III 165, 11* (saddhāya sīlena sutena ~iyā …); Th 75 (~i vaḍḍhati); Ja III 368, 24* (no ce assa sakā ~i); V 399, 17* (sippena vijjācaraṇena ~iyā narā upetā); Peṭ 122, 23 (… cakkhu ~i medhā paññā …); Nett 121, 26 (cittasamādhi bhāvito … ~iṃ paripūreti); Mil 93, 12 (aṭṭhahi kāraṇehi ~i pariṇamati paripākaṃ gacchati); Sp 172, 2 (yesaṃ hi dhātūnaṃ gati attho ~i pi tesaṃ attho); Pj I 15, 15 (sabbadhammabujjhanasamatthāya ~iyā buddho ti); Sadd 481, 26 (budha avagamane: … ~i); 482, 6 foll. (bujjhatī ti ~i … atha vā bujjhanaṃ ~i); — buddhiyā in Ee at Vin II 283, 9* is wr for vuddhiyā ( Be, Ce so; Se vuḍḍhiyā); — buddhī in Ee at Ap 24, 1 is wr for suddhi ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — ifc see pabhinna- ( sv pabhindati ); — °- carita , mfn. , of an intelligent disposition; Vism 102, 2 foll. (… saddhācarito ~o vitakkacarito ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee buddha-); Nidd-a I 316, 7 ; — °- cariyā , f. , behaviour informed by understanding; intelligent disposition; Vism 101, 24 (rāgacariyā … ~ā vitakkacariyā ti); Sv 60, 19 (~āya koṭiṃ patvā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se buddha-) ≠ Mp IV 92, 18 ( Be, Ce, Ee so; Se buddha-); Ud-a 134, 8 (~aṃ paramakoṭiṃ pāpetvā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se buddha-); Cp-a 335, 22* (satthā ~āya pāragū); — °- nisāna , n. , sharpness of intelligence; Nidd-a I 319, 13 = Paṭis-a 581, 33 ; — °- ma(t) , mfn. , intelligent; wise; Vin III 172, 18 (manussā … paṇḍitā °-manto); Nidd I 55, 21 (dhīro paṇḍito paññavā °-mā); 93, 15 (ñāṇī °-mā vibhāvī medhāvī); Ap 24, 2 (ye keci °-mā sattā); Mil 113, 8 (na sakkā aññena sandassetuṃ aññatra tavādisena °-matā ti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se °-mantenā ti); 124, 3 (ayaṃ … pañho … visayo °-mantānaṃ); 294, 6 (tavādisena °-mantenā vinā); Mhv 5:71 (°-mā); — abuddhima(t), mfn. , not wise; foolish; Pv 32:6; — subuddhima(t), mfn. , very wise; Ap 569, 6 ; — abuddhi , f. and mfn. , 1. ( f. ) lack of understanding; Nidd I 458, 1 (~-vihatattā buddhipaṭilābhattā buddho) = Paṭis I 174, 15 ; — 2. ( mfn. ) lacking understanding, foolish; Ps III 227, 21 (bālehi ~īhi paññattaṃ) = Spk II 339, 12 ; — atibuddhi , mfn. , of extreme intelligence; Mil 90, 1* (~i vicakkhaṇo Milindo); — see also aniccalabuddhi(n) ( sv cala ), abuddhika, appabuddhika ( sv appa ), dubbuddhi(n), dvaṅgulabahalabuddhika ( sv dvi ), paraneyyabuddhi(n) ( sv para ), neyyabuddhika ( sv para ), sabuddhika, subuddhi(n).
CPD: a-buddhā or a-buddhi , see a-bujjhi above.

DOP: bujjhana n. [ from bujjhati; cf BHS budhyana], realising, being aware of; recognising; understanding; Paṭis I 18, 16 (°’-aṭṭho); Mil 194, 1 (aparipakke ñāṇe ~aṃ natthi); Vism 678, 27 (°’-aṭṭhena bodho ti laddhanāmassa ariyamaggassa, Be, Se so; Ce bodhī ti; Ee wr bojjhaṅganaṭṭhena bodhī ti); Spk III 145, 5 (maggena vā kilesacchindanato ca °’-atthāya, Ce so; Ee wr kilesaniddānato; Be, Se kilesaniddāto pabujjhanatthāya); Mp II 19, 6 (sambodhāyā ti catunnaṃ saccānaṃ °’-atthāya); Th-a I 8, 20 (sammā sāmaṃ sabbadhammānaṃ ~ato bodhanato ca sammāsambodhi); Sadd 482, 7 (bujjhatī ti buddhi … atha ~aṃ buddhi); — abujjhana , n. , lack of understanding; Sp 1096, 18 (ananubodhā ti ~ena) ≠ Mp III 1, 6 .
CPD: a-bujjhana , n. ( neg. nomen actionis from buj- jhati), ignorance; instr. ~ena ajānanena, Sv (ll) 542, 34 (= 'an-anubodhā').
